headline: Public hearing on shopping cart rules, plus proposals to prohibit data centers and change police and fire chief appointment rules.
summary: Two public hearings are listed, one on shopping cart rules and one on accepting Deacon Farm Lane as a public way. Other business includes a National Grid pole on Madison Avenue, a Gloucester Crossing determination, and several grants and election payments.
